about_short_description.short_description: Cobblestone is a full service property management firm that specializes in real estate and property management.

product.name: Property Management Services
product.description: Management of residential and commercial properties including rent collection, maintenance coordination, and tenant communication.

product.name: Cobblestone Cloud Self-Service Portal
product.description: An online platform for residents and property stakeholders to manage documents, messages, payments, and service requests.

product.name: Andelsboligforening Establishment Advisory
product.description: Consulting and management services for forming cooperative housing associations and facilitating property purchases by tenants.

product.name: BASIS Administration
product.description: Basic property administration service for small associations, including financial management and online access to property data.

product.name: Property Purchase Process Support
product.description: Assistance for tenants in purchasing rental properties, including legal, financial, and technical coordination.
